states: 64 × 14 pt black chin, centered 6 pt green dot; Spool and tape absent. Microphone closed.
Only on pointer hover over idle: “Hold or Double Tap <hotkey> to dictate”. Text only; no green dot, brand prefix, Ready label, or cassette.
Attentive still cassette; tape lies flat; “Starting microphone…”.
Live words above flat ribbon faces with audio-reactive waves/twists; reel eyes turn counterclockwise; oval mouth and occasional blink.
Last words / Listening; flat tape, parked reels, patient open eyes. Label confirms capture is still open.
Same live tape and counterclockwise reels; persistent “Latched · tap to finish” plus timer.
Microphone closed; damp ribbon twists, decelerate reels counterclockwise, purse mouth. No new live-wave oscillation.
Final modified text above flat taut tape; stationary reels, relaxed shutters and pressure-pad smile.
Same final text and taut tape; asymmetric shutter/brow looks toward red dotted word; no reel spin.
Same immutable payload; pinch roller engages, reels turn clockwise, mouth feeds a continuous wavy/twisting tape ribbon to the verified destination caret. No success cue yet.
Small satisfied mouth; reels parked; verified text label and destination cue. Tape withdraws only after known outcome.
Final words above taut tape; visible guide brake; “Destination changed · text held”.
Reels stop, brake holds tape; level concerned mouth. No smile/check/success flourish.
Tape held intact, eyes attend to destination, small concern. Never depict a snapped tape or lost payload.
Capture continues: moving tape and counterclockwise reels, concerned brow; warning never replaces live words.
Reels brake without reversing; exposed tape retracts into guide; neutral mouth; “Cancelled · nothing inserted”.
Closed eye shutters, flat mouth, no tape motion; label “Muted”. No green ready.
Parked reels, setup latch, “Install a speech model” or named blocker.
Stationary reel eyes; small progress marker on taut ribbon, thoughtful pursed mouth. No recording motion.
Parked reels, calm mouth, explicit “Updated · Undo”. No rewind until safe undo is confirmed.
Counterclockwise reels and audio-reactive tape only for actual open capture; “Meeting”, timer, track status.
Stationary reels, flat tape, visible pause bars on latch; “Meeting paused”.
Parked reel eyes and thoughtful mouth; small labelled progress marker, no tape transport or capture motion.
Tape guide brake, stopped reels, gentle concern plus exact problem/consequence/recovery.
Stationary tape, asymmetric eye shutter; correction popover owns alternatives and focus.
Closed shutters and setup latch; no recording or readiness claim.
